title: Creamy Chicken Stew
description: A comforting keto stew with chicken and a rich creamy sauce.
instructions: 2. In a large Dutch oven, cook the spicy sausage over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
3. Remove the cooked sausage from the pot with a slotted spoon and set it aside.
4. Add the chicken breast to the pot and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
5. Add the heavy cream to the pot and stir to combine.
6. Return the cooked sausage to the pot and stir to combine.
7. Bring the stew to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes or until heated through.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
